use_when: 应用链接
延时链接
通用链接
AppGallery跳转
如何通过App Linking应用链接拉起指定应用并传递参数
如何实现应用未安装时直达应用市场下载详情页
如何使用延迟链接在用户安装应用后自动跳转到原始目标页面
如何创建聚合链接实现跨平台统一链接分发
如何开通App Linking服务并完成基本准备工作
如何实现扫码直达、社交分享、沉默唤醒、广告引流等链接跳转场景
当开发者需要实现跨应用或跨平台的链接跳转能力时，应使用App Linking Kit
如果你的应用需要通过链接从浏览器、短信、邮件或社交媒体直接拉起应用内指定页面，App Linking Kit提供了标准化的App Linking链接方案
适用于内容分享、营销推广、广告引流等需要通过链接引导用户进入应用指定页面的场景
当开发者需要处理应用未安装时的链接跳转场景时，应使用App Linking Kit的直达应用市场能力和延迟链接能力
如果希望未安装应用的用户点击链接后直接跳转应用市场下载，并在安装后自动跳转到原始目标页面，App Linking Kit提供了完整的解决方案
当你需要通过一条链接适配多个平台和安装状态时，应使用App Linking Kit的聚合链接能力，实现跨平台的统一链接分发
配置深度链接把用户直接带到商品详情页 / Configure deep links to open the product detail page directly
生成可分享的活动推广链接并回流到应用内指定页面 / Generate shareable campaign links that route back to a specific in-app page
实现从短信邮件社媒链接一键打开应用内容 / Open app content from links in SMS, email, or social media
接入延迟深链让新用户安装后继续原来的落地页 / Integrate deferred deep links so new users continue to the original landing page after install
未安装应用时跳转到 AppGallery 下载并安装后回到目标页面 / Redirect to AppGallery when the app is not installed and return to the target page after install
为扫码海报或线下物料创建拉起应用的短链接 / Create short links for QR codes or offline posters that open the app
给邀请拉新或裂变分享链接附带渠道参数 / Attach campaign or referral parameters to invite and growth-share links
解析打开应用时携带的链接参数并跳转对应页面 / Parse incoming link parameters on app launch and navigate to the right page
统一管理 Android iOS Web 的同一套落地链接 / Use one unified landing link across Android, iOS, and web
实现广告投放链接点击后直达应用内活动会场 / Route ad-click links directly to an in-app campaign page
为内容文章视频商品生成可被外部打开的链接入口 / Create externally openable links for articles, videos, or products
接入通用链接让浏览器中的链接优先唤起应用 / Integrate universal links so browser links open the app first
do_not_use_when: 需求是用FFRT进行并发编程，建立串行队列、并发队列、任务依赖图或任务伙伴协作，并做超时与长耗时诊断；应改用 function-flow-runtime-kit / The task is to use FFRT for concurrency with serial queues, concurrent queues, task dependency graphs, or task companion cooperation, plus timeout and long-running diagnostics; use function-flow-runtime-kit instead

需求是做Segment Map区间更新查询或用RectPartition求最优矩形划分，以优化UI渲染或游戏输出数量；应改用 fast-kit / The requirement is to perform interval updates/queries with Segment Map or compute optimal rectangle partitioning with RectPartition to optimize UI rendering or game output counts; use fast-kit instead
preconditions: 已在AppGallery Connect中开通并配置App Linking服务 / App Linking service has been enabled and configured in AppGallery Connect
工程已集成对应App Linking SDK依赖且项目签名配置正确 / The project has integrated the required App Linking SDK dependency and has correct signing configuration
应用已完成与链接域名、URI前缀或跳转规则相关的关联配置 / The app has completed association configuration for link domains, URI prefixes, or routing rules
若依赖联网解析或获取延迟链接，设备网络可用 / Device network is available if online resolution or deferred link retrieval is required
inputs: 应用链接或聚合链接URL / app link or unified link URL
目标页面路由与业务参数 / target page route and business parameters
未安装时的回退地址或应用市场目标信息 / fallback URL or AppGallery target information for uninstalled cases
延迟链接场景的安装后拉起参数 / post-install launch parameters for deferred deep link scenarios

postconditions.statement: 已添加用于接收和处理App Linking链接的代码路径，并将链接参数映射到应用内目标页面 / A code path has been added to receive and handle App Linking URLs and map link parameters to an in-app destination
postconditions.judge_prompt: Does the edit set add or modify code/config so the app can receive an App Linking URL or intent/want and route its parameters to a specific in-app page?

postconditions.statement: 已为未安装场景配置回退处理，如网页、应用市场详情页或聚合链接目标 / Fallback handling for uninstalled cases has been configured, such as a web page, AppGallery detail page, or unified-link target
postconditions.judge_prompt: Do the edits configure or reference a fallback destination for users without the app installed, such as a web URL, AppGallery page, or unified-link behavior?

postconditions.statement: 若实现延迟链接，已添加安装后获取原始链接参数并继续跳转的处理逻辑 / If deferred deep linking is implemented, logic has been added to retrieve original link parameters after installation and continue navigation
postconditions.judge_prompt: If deferred deep linking is part of the task, do the edits include logic to fetch deferred link data after install and navigate using those recovered parameters?
